caption_L1: Albania : Age structure from 2009 to 2019 is a area plot. The y-axis plots 15-64 years using a scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.7. A linear scale with a minimum of 2010 and a maximum of 2018 can be found along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: There has been a slight increase in age structure between 2009 and 2019. Although there has been a slight increase in age structure, the figures are very close to each other and it could be argued there has been little if any real change.
